CustomField.description: This field allows for easy identification of products that are sold by operators. Created to support Screen Share, though there may be other products in the future
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this box is checked, it indicates that this product is licensed by operator, not endpoint like other Tanium products. When specified in a quote, the quantity will represent the number of operators and will be discounted based on that number
CustomField.label: Sold by Operators versus Endpoints
